text: In this town, everybody is out partying except me. They will party for anything: a birthday, a Tuesday once because somebody found a nice rock while they are out partying. By the way, I am in here preparing for my job interview. The job is wrapping burgers at Buntown, so I train five AM wrist stretches, two hundred raps before breakfast. I do not eat breakfast; I wrap it fold, fold, tuck roll four seconds too slow.
